rule.name: Bad Certificate Callback Accepting All Certificates
rule.rule_desc: The checked source contains a transport-security exception, insecure endpoint, or certificate-validation configuration. Resolve the effective policy and the connections it governs.
rule.vuln_desc: An attacker on the network may read or alter affected traffic if sensitive data travels over cleartext or the connection accepts an untrusted server. Normal HTTPS endpoints and correctly implemented validation do not establish exposure.
rule.developer: Use HTTPS with normal certificate-chain and hostname verification. Remove permissive production callbacks and broad transport exceptions; restrict any justified exception to a documented, non-sensitive endpoint.
rule.reviewer: Any unconditional true return in badCertificateCallback is a critical finding. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: LogInterceptor with Response Body in Non-Debug Build
rule.rule_desc: The code writes diagnostic data or exposes detailed errors. Establish the values emitted, production configuration, and recipients of the output.
rule.vuln_desc: Readers of exposed diagnostics may obtain credentials, private records, internal paths, or implementation details that enable account misuse or targeted attacks.
rule.developer: Keep sensitive values and detailed errors out of user-facing responses and routine logs. Redact before emission, restrict diagnostic access, and verify production logging configuration.
rule.reviewer: Confirm LogInterceptor with body logging is restricted to debug builds. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Dio BaseOptions Without Connection Timeout
rule.rule_desc: The code configures failure handling or resource consumption. Determine whether failure paths preserve security invariants and whether work is bounded.
rule.vuln_desc: Unhandled failures or unbounded work may disrupt availability or leave security-relevant state inconsistent. The presence or absence of a named handler alone does not establish a reachable security defect.
rule.developer: Bound resource use, handle failures at the correct ownership boundary, and fail safely before updating trusted state. Test exceptional paths, cancellation, timeouts, and recovery behavior.
rule.reviewer: Confirm all Dio instances have timeouts configured. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
